items.title: 过去完成进行时的意义与时间参照
items.brief: had been doing：到过去某刻一直在做

concept.summary: 过去完成进行时由 had been + 现在分词构成，表示动作从过去更早的时间开始，一直持续到另一个过去时刻，镜头对准这段持续的过程，动作可能仍在继续。它必须有双层过去参照：一个更早的起点和一个过去的时间终点。与过去完成时相比，它突出过程未间断，常用来交代背景或解释原因。

sections.p: 结构是 had been 加现在分词，所有人称同形。时间上需要两个过去点：动作起点更早，参照点（when 从句、by then、that morning）稍晚。没有过去参照点就无法使用这个时态。
bullets: She had been working in the lab for six hours when the lights went out.
He had been waiting for two hours before the bus finally came.
否定：He hadn't been feeling well for days before he saw the doctor.

sections.p: 一是交代背景，用持续的过程铺垫主事件；二是解释原因，用之前一直在做的事说明过去某个可见的结果。两种功能都要求动作可延续。
bullets: 背景：They had been driving for six hours when they saw the sea.
原因：The ground was wet because it had been raining all night.
情绪铺垫：She had been hoping for a letter, but none came.

sections.p: 状态动词与瞬间动词都不能进入这个时态；时间状语必须是 for 加时间段、since 加起点、all day 等能覆盖从更早到参照点的结构。
bullets: × I had been knowing him for years. → √ I had known him for years.
× They had been arriving for two hours.
√ had been waiting / working / raining / driving / hoping

examples.en: She had been working in the lab for six hours when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 灯灭的时候，她已经在实验室工作了六个小时。
examples.note: for six hours 覆盖从更早到 went out 的整个过程。

examples.en: He had been waiting for two hours before the bus finally came.
examples.zh: 他等了两个小时公交车才来。
examples.note: before 从句的 came 是过去参照点，等待持续到那时。

examples.en: The ground was wet because it had been raining all night.
examples.zh: 地面是湿的，因为下了一整夜雨。
examples.note: 用持续的过程解释过去可见的结果。

examples.en: I had been knowing him for years.
examples.note: know 是状态动词，不能用于进行时，应改为 had known。

examples.en: They had been arriving at the airport for two hours.
examples.zh: 他们到机场已经两个小时了。
examples.note: arrive 是瞬间动词，没有持续时间，应改为 had been at the airport for two hours.

examples.en: He had been writing the report for three hours when the computer crashed.
examples.zh: 电脑死机时，他已经写了三个小时报告。
examples.note: 写报告是可延续的动作，crashed 是过去参照点。

examples.en: She had been teaching for ten years when she got promoted.
examples.zh: 她获得晋升时已经教了十年书。
examples.note: for ten years 与 when 从句共同构成双层过去参照。

pitfalls.wrong: I had been knowing her for ten years before we got married.
pitfalls.right: I had known her for ten years before we got married.
pitfalls.why: know 表示持续的状态而非过程，状态动词只能用过去完成时，不能加 been doing。

pitfalls.wrong: She had being waiting for an hour when the train came.
pitfalls.right: She had been waiting for an hour when the train came.
pitfalls.why: 结构是 had been 加现在分词，been 不能写成 being。

pitfalls.wrong: The old man had been dying for three years before his son returned.
pitfalls.right: The old man had been dead for three years before his son returned.
pitfalls.why: die 是瞬间动词，无法表示持续三年，持续状态要用 be dead。

contrast.diff: 过去完成时报道到过去某点已完成的结果，过去完成进行时报道到过去某点一直在进行的过程，是否强调持续与未完成是分界。

concept.mnemonic: had been 加 ing，过去某点回头看；之前一直在忙活，背景原因都靠它。

core: 构成：had been + 现在分词，所有人称同形
需要双层过去参照：更早的起点加稍晚的过去参照点
强调持续的过程，可能仍在继续，常交代背景或解释原因
常带 for 加时间段、since 加起点、all day
状态动词与瞬间动词不能用：know 用 had known，die 用 had been dead
review.trigger: 句中已有过去参照点，又要交代在那之前一直在做 → 用 had been doing

quickCheck.q: “地面是湿的，因为下了一整夜雨”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: The ground was wet because it had been raining all night.

quickCheck.q: had been knowing 为什么错？
quickCheck.a: know 是状态动词，只能用 had known。

quickCheck.q: 过去完成进行时需要几个过去时间点？
quickCheck.a: 两个：动作起点与稍晚的过去参照点。

drills.stem: The road was still wet because it ___ all night.
drills.explain: 主句 was 确立过去参照点，下雨从更早持续到那时，用 had been 加现在分词强调过程。
drills.trap: had rained 只说明下过雨这一完成事实，不能表达整夜持续下雨的过程。

drills.stem: She ___ (wait) for three hours when the doctor finally called her name.
drills.hint: for three hours 覆盖从更早到 called 的整个过程。
drills.explain: called 是过去参照点，等待在此之前已持续三小时，用过去完成进行时 had been waiting。

drills.stem: He had being working on the farm since sunrise.
drills.answer: He had been working on the farm since sunrise.
accept: He had been working on the farm since sunrise.
drills.explain: 过去完成进行时的结构是 had been 加现在分词，been 是 be 的过去分词，不能写成 being。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: They had been driving for six hours when they saw the sea.
drills.explain: saw 是过去参照点，驾驶从更早持续六小时，用 had been driving 铺垫背景。

drills.stem: 我们到达时，她已经在外面的雨里等了两个小时。
drills.answer: She had been waiting in the rain outside for two hours when we arrived.
drills.explain: arrived 是过去参照点，等待在此之前已持续两小时，强调过程用 had been waiting；被动形式 had been waited 与主语是主动关系不符。

drills.stem: By the time the ambulance arrived, the injured man ___ on the ground for nearly half an hour.
drills.explain: by the time 从句的 arrived 是参照点，躺在地上从更早持续近半小时，用 had been lying。
drills.trap: had lied 是 lie 作说谎讲的过去完成时，与躺着的含义无关，两者同为 lie 的不同义项。

items.title: 过去完成进行时与过去完成时的区别
items.brief: 过程用 been doing，结果用 had done

concept.summary: 两者的参照点相同，都在过去；区别在于说话人关注过程还是结果。过去完成进行时表示到参照点时动作仍在进行或刚刚结束、尚未完成；过去完成时表示到参照点已经完成、并留下结果。第二个判据是次数与数量：出现 three times、four papers 这类计数信息时只能用过去完成时。第三是动词性质：状态动词和瞬间动词都只有过去完成时。

sections.p: 同一个场景换时态，含义随之改变：进行时暗示动作可能还没结束，完成时断言动作已经结束。判断时看上下文有没有未完成的证据。
bullets: When I arrived, he had been cleaning the windows.（可能还没擦完）
When I arrived, he had cleaned the windows.（已经擦完）
She had been writing the report when I came in.（还在写）
She had written the report when I came in.（已写完）

sections.p: 计数信息只能由完成时承载；状态动词没有过程，也只能用完成时；结果动词（finish, arrive, stop）无法拉长为持续过程，同样退回完成时。
bullets: × He had been writing three reports. → √ He had written three reports.
× I had been knowing the truth. → √ I had known the truth.
× By the time I got there, he had been leaving. → √ he had left

sections.p: for 加时间段、since 加起点、all day 偏向进行时，用来标出过程的跨度；already、just、by then、by the end of 偏向完成时，用来标出完成的节点。状语与体貌要匹配，不能互相拖累。
bullets: had been doing 配 for / since / all day
had done 配 already / just / by then / by the end of
× by the time ... had been finishing → √ had finished

examples.en: When I arrived, he had been cleaning the windows.
examples.zh: 我到的时候，他正在擦窗户，可能还没擦完。
examples.note: 擦窗的过程持续到到达时，可能还没结束。

examples.en: When I arrived, he had cleaned the windows.
examples.zh: 我到的时候，他已经把窗户擦完了。
examples.note: 到到达时窗已擦完，强调完成的结果。

examples.en: They had been building the bridge for two years before it collapsed.
examples.zh: 桥塌之前，他们已经建了两年。
examples.note: for two years 标出过程跨度，与进行时匹配。

examples.en: They had built three bridges by 2010.
examples.zh: 到 2010 年他们已经建了三座桥。
examples.note: three bridges 是完成数量，只能用过去完成时。

examples.en: He had been writing three reports before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止日期前他写了三份报告。
examples.note: three reports 是计数信息，应改为 had written。

examples.en: I had been finishing the work when she called.
examples.zh: 她打电话时我快做完那份工作了。
examples.note: finish 是结果动词，动作在终点完成，不能拉长为过程，应改为 had finished 或 was finishing。

examples.en: By the time I got there, he had left.
examples.zh: 我到那儿时，他已经走了。
examples.note: by the time 标出完成节点，用过去完成时。

pitfalls.wrong: He had been writing three reports before the deadline.
pitfalls.right: He had written three reports before the deadline.
pitfalls.why: three reports 是计数信息，进行时描述连续过程，无法承载次数与数量。

pitfalls.wrong: By the time I got there, he had been leaving.
pitfalls.right: By the time I got there, he had left.
pitfalls.why: leave 是瞬间动词，动作在瞬间完成，不能构成持续过程；by the time 标出的是完成节点。

pitfalls.wrong: I had been knowing the truth all along.
pitfalls.right: I had known the truth all along.
pitfalls.why: know 是状态动词，只有状态没有过程，不能进入进行时。

contrast.withTitle: 过去完成进行时的意义与时间参照
contrast.diff: 参照点讲构成与双层过去时间；本点给出与过去完成时的取舍标准：要过程选 had been doing，要结果、数量或状态选 had done。

concept.mnemonic: 过程没完 been doing，结果完成 had done；次数数量一出现，进行时立刻退场。

core: 同参照点：看过程用 had been doing，看结果用 had done
计数信息 three times / four papers → 只能用 had done
状态动词 know、结果动词 finish/leave → 只能用 had done
for/since/all day 偏向进行时；already/by then 偏向完成时
by the time 常与 had done 搭配表完成节点
review.trigger: 选定过去完成体系后 → 问动作完了吗、有没有次数 → 没完且能延续才用 had been doing

quickCheck.q: “我到时他正在擦窗，可能没擦完”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: When I arrived, he had been cleaning the windows.

quickCheck.q: “到 2010 年他们建了三座桥”用哪个？
quickCheck.a: 过去完成时：They had built three bridges by 2010.

quickCheck.q: had been leaving 为什么错？
quickCheck.a: leave 是瞬间动词，不能构成持续过程，应改为 had left。

drills.stem: When I got home, the children ___ TV for three hours, and the living room was a mess.
drills.explain: for three hours 标出从更早到 got home 的过程跨度，客厅凌乱是过程留下的现状，用过去完成进行时。
drills.trap: had watched 表示已经看完，与客厅一团糟所暗示的持续过程不符。

drills.stem: By the end of the term, she ___ (write) four papers.
drills.explain: four papers 是计数信息，且 by the end of the term 标出完成节点，只能用过去完成时 had written。

drills.stem: He had been writing three reports before the deadline.
drills.answer: He had written three reports before the deadline.
accept: He had written three reports before the deadline.
drills.explain: three reports 是数量，过去完成进行时只描述连续过程，不能承载计数信息，须改为 had written。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She had been preparing dinner when the guests arrived.
drills.explain: arrived 是过去参照点，做饭从更早持续到那时且未必完成，用 had been preparing。

drills.stem: 我到的时候，他们已经等了两个小时，但还没买到票。
drills.answer: When I arrived, they had been waiting for two hours but still hadn't got the tickets.
drills.explain: 等待强调过程，用 had been waiting；还没买到票是到参照点为止的结果，用过去完成时；两个体貌在同一句里分工。

drills.stem: She ___ the whole report by the time the meeting began.
drills.explain: by the time 标出完成节点，报告已全部完成，用过去完成时强调结果。
drills.trap: had been finishing 强调过程未结束，与 by the time 表到那时已完成冲突。
